source_warning_reviews.EXPORT-RASTER: PNG is the requested slide preview. PDF/SVG are vector deliverables; TIFF is unnecessary for this PDF presentation.
source_warning_reviews.FINAL-WIDTH: Figures are explicitly slide-sized, not final journal-production figures.
source_warning_reviews.LOG-GUARD: The source asserts that every final raw TMT-B time is positive before using np.log; detector does not recognize the column expression.
source_warning_reviews.UNCERTAINTY-ENCODING: The metrics are pooled OOF values on one fixed partition. Support panels are counts of the five fits. Neither is displayed as a mean with an invented interval.

exports: Five editable PDF/SVG figures and 300-dpi PNG previews; all exported PDFs have selectable text and mandatory geometry checks passed.
